chunks: Muhammad ibn Ali Majilawah narrated to me from Muhammad ibn Abi al-Qasim from Muhammad ibn Ali al-Qurashi from Ali ibn Uthman ibn Wazir from Muhammad ibn Furat, uncle of Hammad al-Sayrafi, from Jabr ibn Yazid from Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) who said:
The Messenger of God (peace be upon him and his family) said: Beware of the false oath, for it leaves the dwellings empty of their residents.
ai.seo_question: What is the consequence of taking false oaths according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: In this hadith from Shaykh al-Saduq’s *Thawab al-A'mal*, the Prophet (SAWW) links the specific sin of false oaths (*al-yamin al-fajirah*) to tangible socio-economic consequences, noting that it leaves dwellings empty as inhabitants depart or perish. This reflects the Shia scholarly understanding that moral corruption in communal life directly impacts physical stability and demographic continuity, serving as a divine warning against the erosion of social trust.
